privacy_s1_body:
CareChat is a health education app for people in India. This notice explains what we collect and why, under India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023.
Contact for privacy questions or complaints: [add grievance officer name and email before launch].
privacy_s2_body: Your email address if you sign in. The reports you upload and the questions you ask. Health details you choose to add, such as age, conditions, medicines and diet. Basic usage counts, such as how many reports were read each day.
privacy_s3_body: Before a report is read, names, phone numbers, addresses and ID numbers are removed. You black out names on photos yourself. The remaining values are read by an AI model from Anthropic, which may process them outside India. Anthropic does not use this data to train its models.
privacy_s4_body: Your account and reports are stored, encrypted, on Zoho Catalyst servers in India.
privacy_s5_body: Without an account or saved history: reports and chats are deleted 24 hours after upload. With saved history: kept until you delete them or turn history off. Records of your consent are kept to show what you agreed to, without health details.
privacy_s6_body: Only you. CareChat staff see counts, never your name next to your health values. Answers marked unhelpful are reviewed by clinicians without anything that identifies you. We never sell your data or show ads.
privacy_s7_body: You can download your results, change your details, turn saved history off, or delete everything at any time from Settings. You can withdraw consent the same way.
privacy_s8_body: CareChat is for adults 18 and over.
terms_s1_body: CareChat explains health information for learning only. It does not diagnose, treat or prescribe. Always follow your doctor's advice.
terms_s2_body: CareChat is not an emergency service. In an emergency call 112, or 108 for an ambulance. For mental health support call Tele-MANAS on 14416.
terms_s3_body: Values are copied from your report by software and can be wrong. Check them against the paper report.
terms_s4_body: Each person can read a limited number of reports and ask a limited number of questions each day. Don't upload reports of people who haven't agreed.
terms_s5_body: We may update these terms. If we do, we will ask you to agree again.
